$comment: DRY-TREAT (STAIN-PROOF, impregnating sealers for stone, tile, concrete and masonry) runs a PHP site with server-rendered pages under /sealers/<category>/<product>. Product pages have the product name (first h1) and a meta description. The site returns ACCESS_DENIED to plain HTTP requests from this network, while headless Chrome gets the page, so fetch.engine is browser. There is no price (distributor and applicator sales), so price is not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The product image is a generic panel image and is not used. There are no specs: the technical data is in PDF data sheets. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: ACCESS_DENIED; browser: SUCCESS with title and description; ai-crawler-avalai: ACCESS_DENIED (the page is blocked from the AvalAI fetch too). Needs APP_BROWSER_ENABLED on the instance. Checked against the saved (Chrome-rendered) Premium Waterborne Impregnating Sealer page on 2026-11-19.
